plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift so percentage work is grounded in a real baseline, and the main training starts in Week 2. With only one 30-minute S&C session each week, the plan keeps the highest-value work first: explosive lower-body power, main strength, a simple upper-back or trunk support piece, and short low-impact conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and power with simple explosive work, crisp lifting, and enough conditioning to support boxing without stealing recovery.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength lift and keep power output sharp while conditioning stays supportive and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more toward fast, sharp outputs and lower-fatigue power expression while keeping enough strength to hold the gains.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Land quietly and reset between reps. Jump fast and tall, not tired.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height that lets you land in a strong athletic position.

exercises.name: 2. Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.notes: Warm up progressively, then work up to one hard clean top set of 3-5 reps. Leave form intact and log the load and reps so future percentages are accurate.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max.

substitutionOptions.name: Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if trap bar setup is unavailable and stay upright with clean depth.

exercises.name: 3. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Pull to the lower ribs and pause briefly at the top. Keep the chest glued to the pad.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a neutral grip and keep the torso quiet.

exercises.name: 4. Assault Bike Aerobic Intervals
exercises.notes: Smooth hard efforts, not a sprint. Keep breathing under control so you finish stronger than you started.

endurancePrescription.target: Build aerobic support without adding impact or too much fatigue
